 Dated : 19th December 2025
 P.C.:
1.

Heard Mr. Kadtane, learned Counsel appearing for the Applicant and Mr. Mangaonkar, learned
App for the State.

2. This Application is filed under Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking pre-arrest
bail in connection with C.R. No.231 of 2022 registered with Pimpri-Chichwad Police Station, Pune
City, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 306, 511, 116, 504, 506 read with Section 34
of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
Perusal of record shows that the the learned Single Judge has granted interim protection by Order dated 8 th June 2022 and same protection has been continued til date.
In the meanwhile, the Charge-sheet is filed on 14th July 2025.

sentences.text:
Thus, in the facts and circumstances, the Anticipatory Bail Application is disposed of in terms of the Order dated 8 th June 2022 and on, the following additional conditions :
(i) In the event of arrest, the Applicant - Balaji Madhav Naikwade be released on bail in C.R. No.231 of 2022 registered with Pimpri-Chichwad Police Station, Pune City, on executing P.R. bond of Rs.25,000/- and furnishing one or two sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when called by the Police and shall co- operate with the investigation.

(iii) The Applicant shall furnish his cell phone number and residential address to the Investigating Officer and Dusane 921 ABA 1468.22.DOC shall keep the same updated, in case of any change thereto.
(iv) The Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat, or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade such a person from disclosing the facts to the Court or to any Police personnel.
(v) The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and shall not contact or influence the Complainant, or any witness, in any manner.
5. The Anticipatory Bail Application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
(MADHAV J. JAMDAR, J.) Dusane Balaji Madhav Naikwade vs State Of Maharashtra on 19 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144265854/
